actual: Fresh-seed replication passed: one-frame sampled Q1 rose 135% (694 to 1,628 frames), while Mean rose 67% (2,626 to 4,387). The prespecified Q1 difference was +934 frames, with a 95% shared-seed bootstrap interval of +767 to +1,114; all three sampled repetitions improved, and all 2,048 games passed strict terminal audit.
